test_cases.name: refine_stiff_dialogue
test_cases.input: 帮我改一下这段AI漫剧对话，让它更自然：男主：我喜欢你。女主：我也喜欢你。
assertions: Provides rewritten version with distinct character voices and subtext
Keeps lines short and suitable for short video

test_cases.name: generate_conflict_scene
test_cases.input: 写一段AI漫剧里霸总和女主吵架的对话，女主要有性格，不要太软。
assertions: Creates short, punchy lines with clear conflict
Gives each character a distinct voice
Includes action beats or visual cues

test_cases.name: character_consistency_check
test_cases.input: 这个角色之前说话很冷静，现在这段对话突然变得很激动，帮我调整得更一致。
assertions: Adjusts dialogue to match established calm personality
Preserves emotional intent while improving consistency
Suggests how to show intensity through subtext or action instead
